task: Durable job scheduler (ae.jobs) with write-ahead journal, retries, dependencies and crash recovery
reasoning_summary: State is a fold over journaled events (append before apply), so recovery is replay plus closing dangling attempts. Handlers run outside the lock and a settleBlocked fixed point re-derives cascades. Tests pin literal backoff times, sweep a crash at every append (and double crashes), truncate/flip every byte, and compare random DAGs to an oracle.
